en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,
‘I saw Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> dyeing with the henna, a red dyeing’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from ibn Khalid from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “
I saw abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, had applied hair dye with henna of red color.’”
